title: Settings
subtitle: Your brand identity, company details, and platform protection — applied across the portals and the website.

leads.duplicateDetectionEnabled: Fold repeat submissions into one lead
leads.duplicateWindowSeconds: Treat as the same lead within (seconds)

tracking.title: Tracking & consent
tracking.subtitle: What the website is allowed to measure, who it asks first, and where each measurement is sent.

unavailable.title: Tracking settings aren’t available yet
unavailable.description: The settings service didn’t return a tracking group. It appears the moment the service starts with this version — no migration needed.

consent.title: Consent
consent.subtitle: The banner visitors see before anything is measured.
consent.bannerEnabledHelp: Shows the consent banner on every page until a visitor decides.
consent.bannerOffWarning: With the banner off nobody is asked, so nothing is granted — every destination below stays dormant. Turn it off only if you have another lawful basis in place.
consent.rememberDaysHelp: Between {{min}} and {{max}} days. After that, visitors are asked again.
consent.categoriesNote: Visitors decide per category: essentials are always on, analytics and marketing are theirs to grant. Each destination below names the category that gates it.

link.unset: Not linked yet — the banner will render without this link.
link.invalid: Enter a site path starting with “/” or a full https:// address.

reask.help: Raises the version, so every visitor is asked once more.
reask.saveFirst: Save your changes before asking everyone again.
reask.title: Ask every visitor again?
reask.message: This raises the policy version. Every visitor — including those who already decided — is asked once more on their next page view. Existing decisions stop applying immediately.
reask.done: Every visitor will be asked again.

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.subtitle: Each one loads only after a visitor grants the category that gates it.

ga4.help: Page views and events, reported in the GA4 property.

gtm.help: A container that loads whatever tags you configure inside it.

metaPixel.help: Conversions for Facebook and Instagram campaigns.

warnings.doubleCounting: Google Analytics 4 and Tag Manager are both on. If the container also loads GA4, every session is counted twice.
warnings.gtmOutsideGate: Tags configured inside the container are loaded by Tag Manager, not by this platform. We set Consent Mode; each tag in the container must be set to honour it.
warnings.ambiguousId: This value also matches the format of: {{others}}. Check you pasted it into the right field.

errors.invalidId: That doesn’t look like a valid ID. It should look like {{example}}.
errors.fixFieldsFirst: Nothing was saved — fix the highlighted fields first.
